title: Godot 4.4 on Linux - Prompt popup button areas are incorrect, cannot click on whole surface
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS 22.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 860M (nvidia; 535.183.01) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4710HQ CPU @ 2.50GHz (8 threads)

### Issue description

Since upgrading from Godot 4.3 to 4.4.1 on Linux Ubuntu 22.04 (Unity desktop), I found the popup mouse recognition to be erratic.

For instance, when deleting a node, the popup button areas are sometimes only covering a small part at the bottom of the button.

After moving the popup window, the button areas are reset to be correct.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e01a1362-b291-42b9-a991-7ed277666940

In the video above, the 1st time button areas are correct, the 2nd time there are very small, then after moving the popup they are correct.

Maybe the button areas themselves are correct but some invisible rectangle is blocking the mouse detection?

### Steps to reproduce

1. Delete a node, or do any other action that prompts a popup.
2. Move the mouse above the different popup buttons

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
